name: castleparcel
description: A clean, login-free, self-hosted file sharer: drop a file, set an expiry, share a link.

scripts.build:spa: npm run build:client && npm run build:webroot
scripts.test:browser: node test/browser/run.mjs && node test/browser/stream-download.mjs && node test/browser/upload-download-flow.mjs && node test/browser/v2-worker.mjs && node test/browser/upload-resume.mjs
scripts.//postinstall: Workaround for upstream bug: libsodium-wrappers-sumo@0.7.16 ships an ESM wrapper that imports ./libsodium-sumo.mjs by relative path but omits that file from its package 'files' field, so it is missing after install. Copy it from the libsodium-sumo dependency. Remove once the upstream package is fixed.
